citations.title: From Microservices Mesh to Streamlined Video Indexing
excerpts: title: From Microservices Mesh to Streamlined Video Indexing
description: Learn how TwelveLabs redesigned video indexing with a layered architecture to scale teams, reduce complexity, and improve performance.
### From Microservices Mesh to Streamlined Layers: Why We Rebuilt Our Internal Video Indexing System

Twelve Labs rebuilt its video indexing platform from a microservices mesh into a layered system after Indexing 2.0 stopped scaling — not in raw compute, but in engineering throughput, deployment portability, and the ability for new contributors to reason about the system end to end.
Stu Stewart, Abraham Jo, SJ Kim, Paritosh Mohan

citations.title: Indexing 3.0: Design Choices for Execution and Deployment
excerpts: title: "Indexing 3.0: Design Choices for Execution and Deployment"
description: Learn the design choices behind Indexing 3.0, from service consolidation and execution layers to portable deployment architectures.
### The Design Choices Behind Indexing 3.0: Consolidation, Packaging, Execution, and Deployment

Twelve Labs details the concrete design decisions behind Indexing 3.0, including why consolidating service boundaries improved extensibility, what single-container packaging enables across deployment environments, the real costs of betting on Ray Serve as the unifying execution layer, and how the system supports multiple deployment targets without fragmenting into separate codebases.
Stu Stewart, Abraham Jo, SJ Kim, Paritosh Mohan
